question: A man receives ₹7,915 per month as salary. He saves 20% of his salary every month. His expenditure per month is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Expenditure % = 100% − **Savings %**

Expenditure % = 100% − 20% = 80%

Expenditure = 7,915 × 0.8 = ₹6,332

**∴ The correct answer is ₹6,332.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Monthly Salary = ₹7,915, Savings % = 20%

**Formula Used:** Expenditure = Total Salary − Savings

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10c4512e1e31e6512a2abf73f2f9093fe631e3bd27c5b9df93874a3aa09c97c1.png] 

⇒ Monthly Savings = 20% of 7,915

⇒ Savings = (20 ÷ 100) × 7,915 = 1,583

⇒ Monthly Expenditure = 7,915 − 1,583

⇒ Expenditure = ₹6,332

**∴ The correct answer is ₹6,332.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Change

If a value is decreased by x%, the new value is (100 − x)% of the original value.

Base Value Concept

In salary problems, the total salary is always considered the 100% base for calculations of savings and expenses.

Income Formula

Income = Expenditure + Savings. This basic arithmetic identity is used for all personal finance aptitude questions.
